title: Rabbi Abba bar Elisha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bereshit Rabbah 80:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.80.7) and [Midrash Tehillim 22:18 (Hyman cites 22:22)](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tehillim.22.18), adding to Resh Lakish’s words. Buber holds that he is the figure mentioned in Yuchasin as Rabbi Abba bar Elishiv, in the time of Rabbi Mani son of Rabbi Yonah. Hyman finds no other mention of him. In [Taanit 23b (Hyman cites 22b)](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.23b.12), only Rabbi Yitzchak bar Elishiv is found, with whom Rabbi Mani was often present. [Vayikra Rabbah 35:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.35.6) mentions Rabbi Acha bar Elishiv.[^1]

notes.text: In both linked midrash passages Rabbi Abba bar Elisha adds two expressions to Resh Lakish’s list. Taanit instead names Yitzchak ben Elishiv, and Vayikra Rabbah names Acha ben Elishiv. Buber’s suggestion about Yuchasin is reported by Hyman.
